actions.name: consume life
actions.desc: As a bonus action, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can target one creature it can see within 5 feet of it that has 0 hit points and is still alive. The target must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw against this magic or die. If the target dies, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} regains [[/healing average]].

actions.name: ephemeral
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't wear or carry anything.

actions.name: variable illumination
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} sheds &reference[bright light] in a 5 to 20-foot radius and &reference[dim light] for an additional number of feet equal to the chosen radius. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can alter the radius as a bonus action.

actions.name: invisibility
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} and its light magically become &reference[invisible] until it attacks or uses its @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.8KSVpQZyzius93ko.Item.RAnyTfj3CGaiGK3W]{Consume Life}, or until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell).

actions.name: incorporeal movement
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can move through other creatures and objects as if they were &reference[difficult terrain]. It takes [[/damage average]] damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
